bubbles.title: Fork bubble to track
bubbles.hint: fork [N] <name>: parent bubble gets a stable id (track nextId counter, lazy, never reused) + fork (relative path to child); child gets parent {track, bubble: id, title}; child title = bubble title; parent state stays as is

bubbles.title: When to fork
bubbles.hint: forks build upon a bubble and keep other domains out of the parent so they don't poison its workflow. If, inside a bubble, the human asks for something completely different: fork, either building on the active bubble (fork) or in a different direction. Then treat the child as a fresh track: ask what to do around the new goal, sketch n bubbles, classify all fog (N: text / N:kk..uu)

bubbles.title: Parent tracks fork
bubbles.hint: child updates flow back to the parent bubble: retitle -> parent renamed, child all done -> parent bubble done. An empty child renders 'all done': only count it finished with >=1 bubble
